component.name: Pebble
component.summary: A beautiful GPU-accelerated terminal for Linux

description.p: Pebble is a WezTerm fork with a curated, zero-configuration look for Linux desktops. It ships the Pebble Quartz color scheme, a unified tab bar and title bar, bundled JetBrains Mono with Nerd Font symbols, native Wayland support with background blur, and sensible defaults for Arch and KDE Plasma 6 users.
Configuration is expressed using Lua. The default experience is designed to work out of the box, while every visual choice can still be overridden in ~/.config/pebble/pebble.lua.
Like WezTerm, Pebble supports tabs, split panes, integrated SSH multiplexing, hyperlinks, ligatures and true color.
